title: Overcurrent during acceleration
description: An overcurrent condition occurs while the motor is accelerating.
possibleCauses: The output circuit is grounded or short circuited.
Motor auto-tuning has not been performed when using SVC or CLVC control.
The acceleration time is too short.
Overcurrent stall prevention parameters are set improperly.
The customized torque boost or V/F curve is not appropriate.
A spinning motor is started.
The AC drive size is too small.
The AC drive is suffering from external interference.
solutions: Eliminate external faults and check for a short circuit in the motor or contactor.
Set the motor parameters according to the motor nameplate and perform motor auto-tuning.
Increase the acceleration time.
Enable and correctly adjust the overcurrent stall prevention function.
Adjust the customized torque boost or V/F curve.
Enable the catching a spinning motor function or start the motor after it stops.
Replace with a larger AC drive.
Check the historical fault records and locate the source of interference.

solutions: Contact the agent or Inovance for inspection.
